items.gate_reason: The relation 'aims-to-reproduce' asserts a goal or end pursued by the subject, which belongs in telos, not dependence.
The relation 'aims-at' expresses goal-direction, which belongs to the telos family, not dependence.
The spirit is the less formulable term and the horse is the image, fitting symbolization rather than manifestation.
Intuition is the less formulable term and lightning is the image, which matches symbolization's direction test, whereas manifestation requires the opposite direction.
The object (the shadow) is the less formulable term and the subject (serpent) is the image, which matches symbolization's direction test, not manifestation's.
The relation 'symbolized-by' asserts that peregrinatio is the image for the opus, fitting symbolization, not doctrinal transmission (derivation).
The string 'aspect-of' is explicitly defined as the inverse direction of the manifestation family, not symbolization.
The quote frames the claim as an act of interpretation by a specific carrier ('This remarkable text explains...'), which outranks other families and belongs in doctrinal-attribution.
The relation asserts that the fish is a symbol for Christ, which belongs in symbolization regardless of the 'attains' language in the quote.
The relation 'corresponds-to' asserts structural likeness without identity, which is correspondence, not privation (which requires lack or negated identity).
Being the fourth person beside the Trinity is a structural-position claim, not a doctrinal derivation.
The equation is explicitly framed as an act of predication by a carrier ('the modern formula'), which dictates doctrinal-attribution over any other family.
The relation 'lacks' asserts an absence or negated capacity, which is the definition of privation, not structural likeness (correspondence).
The dragon is an image representing the less formulable unconsciousness, which fits symbolization rather than correspondence.
Striving after a goal or end state belongs to the telos family, not correspondence.
The indistinguishability rule states that when indistinguishability is asserted of the terms THEMSELVES (not their symbols), it is archetypal-identity.
The relation 'amplified-by' explicitly adduces a parallel to widen the interpretive basis, which defines the amplification family.
Naming or designating a term ('is called') is an act of predication by a carrier, which belongs to doctrinal-attribution.
Having a counterpart in a lower triad asserts structural likeness across registers without identity, which perfectly fits correspondence.

threshold: PASS = every planted item caught with the correct family named (should_be == was) and every class at quota; one miss or misdiagnosis in any class = FAIL. Set 2026-08-12 before the run (RULES #11). Specificity is reported, never gating.
